title: thimbleberrysystems/distill-rank
summary: Distill-Rank通过数学矩阵分解（SVD）去除冗余权重，将大型LLM模型转化为低秩版本，优化推理速度和内存占用，实现大规模LLM与消费级硬件的兼容。
description: Distill-Rank bridges the gap between massive LLMs and consumer hardware. It uses mathematical matrix decomposition (SVD) to strip away redundant weights, delivering a distilled, low-rank version of the model optimized for faster inference and lower memory footprints.
